data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 1.2m on prior year reserves. This has been primarily generated by better than expected claims experience on casualty reinsurance and property reinsurance classes of business.

prior_year_events.event_name: Commutation of casualty quota share contract
prior_year_events.impact_description: reduce the reserve risk from this year by commuting a significant casualty quota share contract at the booked loss ratio

data.standardized_narrative: In 2015, Syndicate 1729 reported an overall surplus of GBP 1.2 million on prior year reserves, representing a release of 9.66% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was primarily driven by better than expected claims experience in casualty reinsurance and property reinsurance lines of business. Additionally, in the 2014 year of account, the syndicate reduced reserve risk by commuting a significant casualty quota share contract.
raw_causal_phrases: overall surplus of GBP 1.2m on prior year reserves
primarily generated by better than expected claims experience on casualty reinsurance and property reinsurance classes of business
commuting a significant casualty quota share contract at the booked loss ratio
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is stated as 'overall surplus' which is typically net of reinsurance; no gross figure for prior year development was explicitly quantified. The claims development table only covers the two most recent underwriting years (2014 and 2015) and thus cannot be used to calculate prior year development for older years.
